column1: Demographic, Health, and Behavioral Characteristics of Survey Participants Who Did And Did Not Report Subjective Cognitive Decline (SCD), Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System Survey, 2023a
Annual income below federal poverty level d

a Taken from respondents to the Subjective Cognitive Decline module.
